title: "Trabalho Jesus"
author: "Daniel"
date: "2023-11-26"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(em)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
dataGentoo = penguins %>% drop_na() %>% 
  filter(species == "Gentoo")
 
dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme_classic()

dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = sex))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme_classic()

set.seed(1)

clusters = kmeans(dataGentoo$body_mass_g, centers = 2)
dataGentoo$clusters = ifelse(clusters$cluster == 1, 1, 0) |> as.factor()

dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = clusters))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
modelo = lm(data = dataGentoo, formula = body_mass_g ~ 1)
summary(modelo)
mean(dataGentoo$body_mass_g)
dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = sex))+
  geom_histogram()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = modelo$coefficients) +
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
set.seed(1)
results <- em(modelo, latent = 2)
emResults = summary(results)
emResults$coefficients
mean(dataGentoo$body_mass_g[dataGentoo$sex == "female"])
mean(dataGentoo$body_mass_g[dataGentoo$sex == "male"])
medias = emResults$coefficients[,1] |> unlist()

dataGentoo$classes = results$post_pr[,1] |> round() |> unlist() |> as.factor()

dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = classes))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme_classic()

dataGentoo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = sex))+
  geom_histogram()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = medias[1], color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = medias[2], color = "blue") +
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
classes = results$post_pr[,1] |> round()

table(dataGentoo$sex, classes)
```
